why: The student wrote a correct index loop in which i serves as the index, so a[i] = a[i] * 10 updates every element. This is a familiar traversal idiom that replaces the given for-each loop, which never changed the array, so it counts as fixing the given code (L3), not solving an unseen problem (L4).

concepts.why: Because the loop variable is the index, a[i] reaches a different element on each pass, and the write goes back into the array.
